intent: create a new inventory item with a name and quantity
benefit: new stock can be tracked from the moment it is registered

scenarios.given: no item exists with name "Widget" and the request body contains a nonblank name "Widget" and quantity 10
scenarios.when: the client sends POST /api/v1/items with the request body
scenarios.then: the service returns HTTP 201 and the persisted item with a generated id, name "Widget", and quantity 10

scenarios.given: the request body contains a blank name and quantity 10
scenarios.then: the service returns HTTP 400 and no item is persisted

scenarios.given: the request body contains name "Widget" and quantity -1
scenarios.then: the service returns HTTP 400 and no item is persisted

intent: update or delete an existing inventory item
benefit: inventory records stay accurate and obsolete items can be removed

scenarios.given: an item with id 42 exists with name "Widget" and quantity 5
scenarios.when: the client sends PUT /api/v1/items/42 with name "Gadget" and quantity 20
scenarios.then: the service returns HTTP 200 with the updated item containing id 42, name "Gadget", and quantity 20
the service returns HTTP 204 and the item is no longer retrievable by id

scenarios.when: the client sends PUT /api/v1/items/999 with a valid name and quantity
the client sends PUT /api/v1/items/42 with a blank name
scenarios.then: the service returns HTTP 400 and the item remains unchanged

scenarios.when: the client sends PUT /api/v1/items/42 with quantity -5
scenarios.then: the service returns HTTP 400 and the item remains unchanged

intent: retrieve an item by id or list all items
benefit: stock records can be inspected and verified

scenarios.given: an item with id 42 exists with name "Widget" and quantity 10
scenarios.then: the service returns HTTP 200 with the item containing id 42, name "Widget", and quantity 10

scenarios.given: multiple items exist in the inventory
scenarios.then: the service returns HTTP 200 with a list containing all inventory items
